templates.title: Date night
templates.summary: The door at dusk, the room, the plate landing, the first bite and what dinner for two cost.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.direction: Start across from the entrance with the sign and the lit windows in frame, then walk slowly to the door until it fills the screen.

captions.script: Date night. We booked a table here and finally made it.
Tonight's table. We booked ahead, so we're all set.
Found our new date night spot. Come in with us.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: Just inside, behind a plant or the door frame
steps.direction: Hold the phone right behind a plant or the door frame, then slide sideways past it until the whole room shows.

captions.script: Look at this room. This is the mood for tonight.
Here is how loud it gets. Can we actually talk in here?
Here is the seat to ask for when you book.

steps.title: The plate
steps.direction: When the plate lands, hold the phone above it at an angle with your elbows on the table and circle a little to one side.

captions.script: Here it comes. Our server said this is the plate to order.
This plate, and you can see why we ordered it.
Two plates, one table, and we are sharing both.

steps.title: First bite
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level with your date or the table behind you. Lift the first bite and react honestly.
steps.prompter: First bite of the dish our server picked for us. Okay, wow.

captions.script: First bite of the dish our server picked for us. Okay, wow.
Not what I expected. Better. I am stealing the rest of this.

steps.title: Book it
steps.position: Seated at the table, phone close
steps.direction: Hold the phone close and a little above your face. Say what dinner for two cost and when to book.
steps.prompter: Here is what dinner for two cost us, and when to book.

captions.script: Here is what dinner for two cost us, and when to book.
Worth the booking. Everything we had, and the total is on screen.

templates.title: Chef's pick
templates.summary: Ask the kitchen what to order, watch it plated at the pass, take the first bite and give the price.

steps.title: Hands at work
steps.position: At the kitchen pass, with the chef's OK
steps.direction: Ask first, then hold the phone straight above the cook's hands at the pass and keep it still while they plate.

captions.script: Made to order, right here at the pass, while we wait.
I asked the chef what to order. This is what they made.
Straight from the pan to the plate, sauce going on now.

steps.title: The cook
steps.position: Behind the cook's shoulder, with their OK
steps.direction: Stand just behind the cook's shoulder and lean in slowly as they finish the plate. You talk on the front camera.
steps.prompter: I asked the chef what to order tonight, and this is it.

captions.script: I asked the chef what to order tonight, and this is it.
Here is the plate the kitchen would pick for themselves.

steps.title: The plate
steps.position: At the pass, phone low at plate height
steps.direction: Rest the phone low at the edge of the pass and move in slowly until the plate fills the screen.

captions.script: The chef's pick tonight. When the kitchen picks it, you order it.
Plated and ready to go out. This is what lands on your table.
Look at that sauce. Ask them how they make it.

steps.title: First bite
steps.direction: Front camera. Start with the fork right at the lens, then pull it away to your mouth and react.
steps.prompter: The chef's pick, first bite. That sauce is the reason to come.

captions.script: The chef's pick, first bite. That sauce is the reason to come.
The chef was right. I would not have ordered this on my own.

steps.title: Come try it
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level with the plate in frame. Say the dish name, the price and the venue.
steps.prompter: Ask for the chef's pick. Here is the price and where we are.

captions.script: Ask for the chef's pick. Here is the price and where we are.
Tell them I sent you, and ask what the kitchen is cooking today.

templates.title: Family table
templates.summary: The kids plate, the family at the table, crayons and high chairs, the parents' plate and the family total.

steps.title: Kids plate
steps.position: Standing at your table, phone above the plate
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the kids plate as it is set down and keep it still.

captions.script: Here is the kids menu plate. Look at what they get.
This is the kids plate. Let's see if it comes back clean.
Kid friendly and the food is actually good. Here is the proof.

steps.title: The table
steps.position: At the end of your table
steps.direction: From the end of the table, turn slowly from one side to the other across your own family and the food.

captions.script: Family dinner, all of us at one table, and nobody is bored.
Here is how much room there is for all of us.
Dinner with the kids, and the parents get good food too.

steps.title: Kid stuff
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the crayons, the kids menu or the high chair tray and move in slowly, then flick the phone to the side.

captions.script: Here is what they bring for the kids at the table.
Here are the little things for kids. Parents, you know why that matters.
Here is what keeps the kids busy, so dinner stays calm.

steps.title: Our plate
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level, your plate in frame. Take a bite of the grown-up dish and react.
steps.prompter: The kids are busy, so here is my plate. First bite.

captions.script: The kids are busy, so here is my plate. First bite.
My turn. The grown-up plate is just as good as the kids one.

steps.title: Family total
steps.position: Seated, arm out over the table
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level so the table shows behind you. Say the total for the family and the venue.
steps.prompter: Dinner for all of us, kids menu included. Here is the total.

captions.script: Dinner for all of us, kids menu included. Here is the total.
Worth it for families. Kids eat well and the bill stays sane.

templates.title: Weekend brunch
templates.summary: The syrup or hollandaise pour, the brunch spread from above, the yolk break, the room and what to order.

steps.title: The pour
steps.direction: Rest the phone on the table edge level with the plate and keep it still while syrup or hollandaise goes on.

captions.script: Brunch time. This is how a weekend should start.
Syrup on the stack, and it keeps going.
Hollandaise going over the eggs. Look at that pour.

steps.title: The spread
steps.direction: Stand up, hold the phone straight down over one plate, then lift it slowly until the whole table fits.

captions.script: Here is what we ordered. Everything is on the table.
Brunch for two, and we may have ordered for four.
The whole table. Look how full these plates come out.

steps.title: Brunch hook
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level, the table in front of you. Say when brunch is served and what you ordered.
steps.prompter: Weekend brunch, here is when they serve it and what we ordered.

captions.script: Weekend brunch, here is when they serve it and what we ordered.
Here is how long we waited, and if it was worth it.

steps.title: Yolk break
steps.direction: Hold the phone above your plate at an angle and move in slowly as the fork breaks the yolk or cuts the stack.

captions.script: The yolk break. Look at that, this is why you order it.
Cutting into the stack. Fluffy all the way through.
Eggs done right, still runny in the middle.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: At your table, phone behind your coffee cup
steps.direction: Start with the lens right behind your coffee cup, then slide sideways past it until the room shows.

captions.script: Here is the room, and nobody is in a hurry.
It fills up fast, so get here early.
Look around and pick your table before it fills.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level with your plate in frame. Name the plate to get, when to come and the price.
steps.prompter: Here is the plate to get, when to come, and what we paid.

captions.script: Here is the plate to get, when to come, and what we paid.
Brunch verdict: come hungry, and here is what to share.

templates.title: Where to sit
templates.summary: A tour of the seats: through the door, the dining room, along the bar, the best table and where to book.

steps.title: The hook
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level, standing in the doorway with the room behind you.
steps.prompter: Every seat in here, ranked: the bar, the booths and the best table.

captions.script: Every seat in here, ranked: the bar, the booths and the best table.
I asked the staff for the best table in the house. Come see.

steps.title: Walk in
steps.direction: Turn to the back camera at chest height and walk slowly to the door until it fills the screen.

captions.script: Come in with me. This is what you see first.
Through the door. Here is how big it is inside.
Here is the entrance. Look for the sign.

steps.title: Dining room
steps.position: Just inside, behind a pillar or plant
steps.direction: Hold the phone right behind a pillar or a plant, slide sideways past it until the dining room shows, then flick the phone to the right.

captions.script: The main room. Here is who it suits and how loud it gets.
Here is the layout: where the booths, tables and kitchen are.
Here is the light in here, for lunch or for dinner.

steps.title: The bar
steps.position: At the bar, phone low on the counter
steps.direction: Rest the phone low on the bar top and slide it slowly along the counter, the bottles above.

captions.script: Here are the bar seats. Good for a quick dinner.
Eating alone? Sit at the bar and talk to the bartender.
Here is whether you need to book a seat at the bar.

steps.title: Best table
steps.position: Standing beside the table you would book
steps.direction: Stand beside the table you would book, hold the phone above it at an angle and lean in slowly over the place setting.

captions.script: This is the one to ask for, and here is why.
Book this table by name. Here is how to ask for it.
This is the date night seat. Trust me on this one.

steps.title: Where to book
steps.direction: Sit at that table, front camera at eye level. Say which seat suits which night.
steps.prompter: Here is which seat suits a date and which suits a quick dinner.

captions.script: Here is which seat suits a date and which suits a quick dinner.
Here is the seat for groups, for couples and for eating solo.

templates.title: Lunch deal
templates.summary: The lunch special: the plate, what it costs, what comes with it, how fast it came, and the Loca offer.

steps.title: The plate
steps.position: Seated, phone low at plate height
steps.direction: Rest the phone low at the table edge and move in slowly until the lunch plate fills the frame.

captions.script: This is the lunch special. Wait until you see the price.
Lunch break win. Here is how fast it came out.
The lunch deal I keep hearing about at work.

steps.title: The deal
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level, the plate in front of you. Say what the deal is.
steps.prompter: The lunch special, and here is exactly what you get for it.

captions.script: The lunch special, and here is exactly what you get for it.
One price, and here is everything that comes with it.

steps.title: The price
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the lunch menu or the board at an angle and move in slowly until the price fills the screen, then flick the phone to the side.

captions.script: This is the lunch price, right on the menu.
Here is when the deal runs, and where it is on the menu.
Here is how it compares to takeout, and you get a table.

steps.title: What comes with it
steps.direction: Stand up and hold the phone straight down over the table, still, while the plates and the drink are set down.

captions.script: All of this comes with it, for the one price.
The full tray, for one lunch price.
Here is what comes with the lunch plate.

steps.title: First bite
steps.direction: Front camera at eye level. Lift the first bite toward the lens and react.
steps.prompter: Here is how fast it came out, for a lunch break.

captions.script: Here is how fast it came out, for a lunch break.
Hot and filling. I will be back on my next lunch break.

steps.title: The offer
steps.direction: Hold the phone a little above eye level, plate in frame. Say the venue name and the Loca offer.
steps.prompter: Check the lunch hours on Loca and grab the offer before you go.

captions.script: Check the lunch hours on Loca and grab the offer before you go.
The lunch offer is on Loca. Use it on your next lunch.

entrance.reads: The storefront grows as we walk up until the door fills the screen; we push through it into the room.

room.reads: The blocker slides off and the dining room opens up behind it; cut down to a plate on the table.

dish.reads: The plate turns past us as its far side comes round; match-cut on the fork lifting off the plate.

bite.reads: The fork comes up into a still selfie and the face answers; cut to a tighter, higher selfie for the bill.

outro.reads: A close, still face from just above while the price and the booking tip land; hold for the end card.

hands.reads: Hands plate the dish from above, nothing else moves; match-cut on the same hands seen from behind the cook.

cook.reads: From behind the cook we lean in as the plate is finished; cut low and level with the plate on the pass.

plate.reads: The plate towers and grows until sauce fills the screen; push through it to the fork at the lens.

bite.reads: The fork leaves the lens and the face appears behind it; cut to a higher, still selfie.

outro.reads: Arm's length from just above, face and plate held still while the price lands; hold for the end card.

kids-plate.reads: The kids plate lands under the lens from above; cut up to the whole table at eye level.

table.reads: The table slides past from left to right; cut down to the crayons and the high chair.

setup.reads: The crayons grow until the colors fill the screen, then the frame flicks away and lands on the parent at the table.

bite.reads: The frame settles out of the whip on a still selfie and the bite; cut to a higher selfie with the table behind.

total.reads: A still selfie from just above with the whole table behind while the total lands; hold for the end card.

pour.reads: The pour runs down the plate while nothing else moves; cut straight overhead to the same plate.

spread.reads: One plate from above, then the camera rises and the whole table appears around it; cut to the selfie.

hook.reads: A still selfie at the table with the spread in front; cut to the back camera above one plate.

yolk.reads: The fork breaks in and the yolk fills the screen; the next shot starts on a detail and pulls back to the room.

room.reads: The cup slides off and the busy brunch room is there behind it; cut to the verdict selfie.

verdict.reads: A still selfie from just above, plate in frame, while the pick and the price land; hold for the end card.

hook.reads: A still selfie in the doorway; cut to the back camera walking at the door.

door.reads: The door grows until it fills the screen; push through it to a shot that opens inside.

room.reads: The pillar slides off and the room opens up, then the frame flicks right and lands low on the bar.

bar.reads: The bar top slides past low with the bottles towering; cut high above the best table.

seat.reads: The table grows as we lean in over the plates and glasses; cut to the verdict selfie.

verdict.reads: A still selfie at the best table while the seat tips land; hold for the end card.

plate.reads: The plate grows from below until it towers in the frame; cut to the selfie.

hook.reads: A still selfie with the plate in front; cut to the back camera above the menu.

menu.reads: The price grows until it fills the screen, then the frame flicks away and lands overhead on the tray.

spread.reads: The plates land around the lunch plate from above; cut to the bite selfie.

bite.reads: The face grows as the bite comes up to the lens; cut to a higher, still selfie for the offer.

offer.reads: A still selfie from just above while the name and the offer land; hold for the end card.
